messages:
alice: Heads-up: legal asked for a 2-year hold on logs for a customer dispute. Our default SIEM export retention is 90d. Need an emergency process for exceptions + contractor access controls.
sanjay: Important. We should avoid long-lived creds being given to contractors. Propose short-lived exported snapshots + JIT IAM role.
tom: Agreed. Two things to sort: 1) where to store the extended-retention snapshot (forensic vs scrubbed) 2) how KMS unwrap will be approved and logged.
alice: For storage, plan: forensic-snapshots bucket (WORM for 2y) with dedicated CMK. Partner/contractor access only via timeboxed presigned URLs generated after approval.
becca: Can we automate approval if request comes from a case with legal flag? E.g., ticket metadata triggers a Lambda that issues a 12h URL. Also need DLP check before handing to partner.
sanjay: DLP must run in the export pipeline. If PII found, mark as "redacted" and require additional legal sign-off for release.
alice: How about audit trail? Every unwrap/presign call needs an immutable record with who approved, ticket id, and reason. That goes to audit-bucket (5y), separate CMK with MFA-delete.
kms-bot: NOTICE: CMK policy update pending review. New key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/forensic-cmk. Rotation: annual.
tom: One technical ask: contractors use SAML-based short sessions today. For exports we should create an assume-role flow that issues temporary credentials scoped to GetObject and List on the presigned URL only. No console access.
becca: Sample presign generator (internal) suggestion:

```
POST /presign
body: {"object":"forensic/2026-03-20/snap.tar.gz","expiry":43200,"ticket":"LEGAL-342"}
response: {"url":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/...","audit_id":"audit-20260320-01"}
```

Generator must call DLP and check "redacted" tag before returning URL.
sanjay: Also add automatic session revocation: if policy-change events (e.g., CMK rotation or key-compromise alert) happen, revoke outstanding presigns and rotate signing key. We can maintain a signing-key table and bump it.
alice: Ops owns the presign service. Security owns the gating and audit requirements. Action items:
- tom: design IAM assume-role template for contractor presign flow + Terraform change
- becca: DLP integration checklist and ticket-triggered Lambda spec
- sanjay: CMK key policy & emergency rotation playbook + audit-bucket config (MFA-delete)
- alice: RFC for legal exception process and sample ticketing flow

tom: I'll add a minimal IAM snippet for review. Rough draft:

```
resource "aws_iam_role" "contractor_presign" {
  name = "contractor_presign"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{ Effect = "Allow", Principal = { Federated = "arn:aws:iam::123456789:saml-provider/okta" }, Action = "sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML" }]
  })
}
```

needs tighter conditions for session duration and external IDs.
becca: Good start. Also ensure all presign-generator actions are logged to CloudTrail and a copy shipped to the audit-bucket.
kms-bot: ALERT: Unwrap calls must include requestor, ticket id, and approver in kms:EncryptionContext. Missing fields will be denied.
alice: Noted. Let's keep the approval flow simple enough to ship this week as an MVP. I'll draft the RFC and share for review.
becca: 👍 small follow-up: add a checklist for forensic vs scrubbed exports in the ticket template so reviewers see data sensitivity up-front.
sanjay: +1. Also set a monitoring alert for any presign generator errors > 1% in a 1h window.
alice: thanks all — filing RFC and assigning owners now.
